_nguon: Bản phủ tiếng Anh của battu_kb.json (QTE-1 tuần 3–4) — chỉ mục nhat_chu, cùng khoá. Chuyển ngữ máy theo bảng thuật ngữ thuat_ngu_en.json, đã qua bộ kiểm app/chuyen_ngu/kiem.py; chờ người bản xứ duyệt.

Giáp.tinh_chat: direct, purposeful, reaching upward and sheltering others
Giáp.mat_toi: rigid, slow to bend, may snap under pressure
Giáp.cau_tu_soi: Are you trying to stand tall where it would be wiser to bend?

Ất.tinh_chat: gentle, tactful, adaptable, good at finding support
Ất.mat_toi: can lean on others too much, plays it safe
Ất.cau_tu_soi: Who are you leaning on — and do you still need to?

Bính.tinh_chat: warm, generous, likes to shine and to be open
Bính.mat_toi: showy, impatient, finds secrets hard to keep
Bính.cau_tu_soi: Who are you shining for — and do you keep some warmth for yourself?

Đinh.tinh_chat: warm, thoughtful, attentive, a light in dark places
Đinh.diem_manh: focused, lights the way for others
Đinh.mat_toi: prone to worry, sways with emotion

Mậu.diem_manh: stable, carries responsibility, keeps their word
Mậu.mat_toi: slow, set in their ways, resists change
Mậu.cau_tu_soi: What are you holding on to only out of habit?

Kỷ.diem_manh: thorough, accepting, good at helping things grow
Kỷ.mat_toi: worries a lot, takes on too much, hesitates
Kỷ.cau_tu_soi: You nurture others — who nurtures you?

Canh.cau_tu_soi: Is your honesty hurting the people you love?

Tân.tinh_chat: refined, cares about presentation, sensitive, a perfectionist
Tân.cau_tu_soi: Which of your standards is wearing you out?

Nhâm.hinh_tuong: a great river or the sea
Nhâm.tinh_chat: clever, free-spirited, loves freedom and movement
Nhâm.mat_toi: hard to rein in, can drift, low staying power
Nhâm.cau_tu_soi: Where are you flowing to — or are you just spilling over?

Quý.mat_toi: overthinks, can turn pessimistic, closes off
Quý.cau_tu_soi: What do you sense but have not yet dared to say?
